newsitem.title: USA: NYC MAC seen getting $58 mln of retail orders.
newsitem.headline: NYC MAC seen getting $58 mln of retail orders.

text.p: The Municipal Assistance Corporation for New York City got about $58.7 million of retail orders for its $490 million bond sale planned for Wednesday, a source close to the deal said on Tuesday.
This would be less than the total amount the MAC got last December, when it received around $80 million of orders for an approximately $677 million refunding.
Officials at MAC and the underwriters were not immediately available to comment.
